fact: Helped run Ramadhan Di Kampus UGM across six editions — from field coordinator to Steering Committee, HRD, and Quality Assurance for a 1.500+ participant program.
long_description:
I contributed to Ramadhan Di Kampus (RDK) UGM across six editions, growing from a **field coordinator** into the **strategic and quality roles** behind a campus-wide Ramadan program serving ##500+ participants## every year. Every edition brings in a wide range of **national-level guests** — scholars (ulama), government officials, community leaders, academics, and practitioners — who anchor the talks and programs we run.

**RDK 1442 H (2021) — Field Coordinator, Nuzulul Qur'an:** Ran the on-the-ground coordination for the Nuzulul Qur'an commemoration, managing logistics, volunteers, and the flow of the ##online event## because of COVID-19.

**RDK 1443 H (2022) — Steering Committee Coordinator & Event Director:** Set the strategic direction for the program and owned its full delivery end-to-end — planning, team structure, and execution of daily and weekly programming under ##strict budget controls##. This was the program's ##first offline and hybrid edition## after the COVID-19 pandemic.

**RDK 1444 H — Person in Charge & Steering Committee:** Served as the person-in-charge and a steering committee member, overseeing the program's ##direction, accountability, and quality## across the whole edition.

**RDK 1445 H — HRD:** Led human resources and people operations — ##recruitment, role assignment, and team development## for the volunteers and committee members behind the event.

**RDK 1446 H — RPL Event Coordinator:** Coordinated the RPL (Ramadan program) events, bringing the agenda to life and keeping every session running ##on schedule and on budget##.

**RDK 1447 H — Quality Assurance Coordinator:** Standardized evaluation and feedback across activities, closing the loop between what was delivered and ##how it could run better next time##.
